title: Notification setting controls align and expose their descriptions accessibly

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 audit and approved improvement scope

detail:
Local source-only candidate75ec93a85 adds alignment and description association. Existing 11 tests and focused lint passed in prior candidate evidence. Reconcile current main before publication; no old branch overwrite. Built 2026-11-09 fresh on main (PR pending the merge queue; the candidate 75ec93a85 is not in the repository or on any remote): the rows declared a sixth grid column nothing filled, so every switch sat one track left of its heading; header and rows now share one track (topic, Email, In-app, Push, SMS). Each switch is named "<Channel> for <Topic>" and described by the topic's own line through aria-describedby, and the follower-reminder switch is named and described the same way. The wired-pair guard, the dash placeholder and the kit `.sw` switches are untouched (lib/notifications/wired.test.ts and components/settings/settings-switches.test.ts still pass). New render test app/(main)/settings/notifications/form.test.tsx pins the shared track and the names. No renders were taken on this box; the manual acceptance (390 and desktop alignment, a screen reader reading channel, topic and description, save and reload) stays with the owner.

2026-11-09: closed on the owner's ruling ("4. B": close without a manual check) after the build merged to main the same day. No production look was taken; the row's unit pins stay green in CI.

verify.evidence: Closed on the owner's ruling, 2026-11-09 18:16Z. Asked "Production checks for #4698, #4700 and #4701: A. We give you a 3-item checklist with links once they're live. B. Close them without a manual check", Daniel answered "4. B". The build merged to main the same day (#4701); its unit pins stay green in CI. No production look was taken.
